name: Web app factory
description: From issue to review-ready pull request. Triage checks the contract, an agent implements, another reviews adversarially, a human merges.
yaml:
name: Web app factory
description: From issue to review-ready pull request. Triage checks the contract, an agent implements, another reviews adversarially, a human merges.
repository: acme/web-app
maintainers: [alice] # only their actions start the factory
model: sonnet # the default model of the agents

setup: npm ci # install the dependencies in each run's checkout
commands: # the project's commands, by name
  test: npm test
  typecheck: npm run typecheck
  lint: npm run lint
checks: [test, typecheck, lint] # run by the engine before any pull request leaves the machine

integrations:
  slack:
    channel: factory
  linear:
    team: ENG
  sentry: # new production errors of this project are investigated
    organization: acme
    project: web-app

webhooks:
  deploy-failed: # your deploy platform posts here, through the relay, when a deploy fails
    signature: standard

mcp:
  docs: # up-to-date documentation of the libraries the code uses
    url: https://mcp.context7.com/mcp

limits:
  usd_per_run: 5
  usd_per_day: 30
  minutes_per_run: 45
  review_rounds: 3 # rounds of internal review before a person takes over

wiki: true # a map of the code in wiki/, for people and agents, written when you ask: the studio's Wiki page or openfabriq run wiki
answer_mentions: true # the agents that open pull requests answer a maintainer's @openfabriq in a comment on them; false turns it off
learning: true
